narration: In month {fork_month}, after {identical_months} months that matched exactly, your first appraisal came with a fixed budget behind it, and you chose {real_choice} where the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. That same month the first score to come apart was {first_bar_apart}, the measure of how much pay was claimed before it arrived. From there the ghost's money sat above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months. In month {layoff_month}, when both of you lost the job at the bottom of the fall, the ghost held {layoff_net_worth_gap}. The ghost's cushion for a stretch with no income ended {safety_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}.
